redirects.//: collarone.app is served by nginx on the VPS (DNS A -> 72.61.156.142). Vercel still builds this repo on every push, so collarone.vercel.app is a SECOND live front-end talking to the same database. The two deploy independently: Vercel lands in seconds, the VPS can fail on a blocked runner IP, so they drift — and a bookmarked vercel.app URL then runs a different build of the product against production data. Send it home instead. /api is left alone so the Vercel crons that call /api/health and /api/automations-run keep working.
